description: Check for devices assigned to a specific category (dependency check)
purpose: Validate that a category can be safely deleted by checking for dependent devices

request.notes: BCM API does not support filtering by category - must query all and filter client-side

error_message_format:
Category '{categoryName}' cannot be deleted because it has {count} device(s) assigned.

Dependent devices:
  - {hostname} (uuid: {uuid})

Resolution options:
  1. Reassign devices to another category before deleting
  2. Delete the dependent devices first
  3. Set 'force = true' to delete anyway (WARNING: will orphan device references)
implementation_notes: Always query all devices - BCM API does not support server-side filtering
Filter client-side by comparing device.category === targetCategoryUUID
Use 5-second timeout for large clusters (1000+ devices)
Cache results if checking multiple categories in same transaction
Empty array means no dependencies - safe to delete
